title: PPF Add-On Pack
description: A mix of add-ons for Pixel Perfection Fidelity.
body:
This is a compilation of add-ons for my pack [Pixel Perfection Fidelity](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/pixel-perfection-fidelity), which this pack depends upon.

Features supported in this pack include:
- Large saplings _(secondary growth stage)_
- Emissive ores _(requires [Continuity](https://modrinth.com/mod/continuity))_
- Better grass
- Better sticky piston
- "Card-like" spawn eggs
- Better pumpking & melon stems
- Renamed some items
- Pebble-like stone button
- Directional arrows for hopper

### **DEPENDENCIES:**
- [Continuity](https://modrinth.com/mod/continuity) (RECOMMENDED)
